title: Registered Nurse – Labor and Delivery
description:
Role: Registered Nurse – Labor and Delivery
Location: Polson, Montana
Type: FTE/Permanent
Shift: Full Time – Night Shift | Per Diem/Variable


2 Full-Time Night Shift positions available

The Registered Nurse (RN) provides professional, comprehensive nursing care for patients in an acute care environment. Responsible for safe, compassionate, and evidence-based care tailored to individual patient needs. Practices in accordance with the Nurse Practice Act, ANA Code of Ethics, and organizational standards.

Required qualifications:
• Graduation from an accredited nursing program
• Upon hire: Montana Registered Nurse License
• Upon hire: National Provider BLS – American Heart Association
• Within 90 days of hire: Provider NRP – American Academy of Pediatrics
• Minimum 1 year of nursing experience

title: RN Director Psych
description:
Role: RN Director Psych
Location: Worcester, MA
Type: FTE/Permanent

Position Summary:
This role provides leadership and support to the senior executive position (CNO) responsible for all nursing and other designated patient care functions/services within the hospital organization. The role will assume responsibility for assisting in assessing, planning, coordinating, implementing, and evaluating nursing practice on a multi-unit level. Role assumes 24/7 responsibility of Director's assigned areas. The role is accountable to support CNO to ensure high quality, safe and appropriate nursing care, competency of clinical staff, and appropriate resource management related to patient care.

Job Responsibilities:
Active and current registered nurse license in the state of residence/practice. Has highly effective interpersonal and communication skills, proven leadership ability and hospital operational ability, and ability to serve as role model and advocate for the professional discipline of nursing.

Qualifications:
Education:
Required: Associate degree from an accredited nursing school with a bachelor's degree in a health care related field or a BSN. MSN or master's in a health care related field.

Experience:
Required: 2 years of progressive management experience in a hospital environment as a manager or director position. Minimum 3 years experience in psych is mandatory to be considered.

Certifications:
Required: Currently licensed, certified, or registered to practice profession as required by law, regulation in state of practice or policy; CPR.

title: Respiratory Care Practitioner
description:
Role: Respiratory Care Practitioner
Locations: Spokane, WA
Type: FTE/Permanent
Shift Details: Full-time, Variable shift, 36 hours a week

Job Description:
  • The Department-based Respiratory Therapist is expected to demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of contemporary Respiratory Therapy principles.
  • He/She will collaborate with Physicians and Nurses in planning and implementing the patient plan of care.
  • Completion of the department orientation program as well as unit-specific orientation, as required, is mandatory.
  • This individual assists the Physician with the delivery and direction of Respiratory Therapy. She/He may be qualified by training and experience to operate and maintain complex ventilatory support systems, monitoring and resuscitation devices, respiratory care procedures and patient assessments, diagnostic procedures and oxygen therapy.
  • Activities may also include other patient care functions for which he or she is qualified.

Required Qualifications:
  • Coursework/Training: Education to meet certification, license, or registration requirement.
  • Washington Respiratory Care Practitioner License upon hire.
  • National Provider BLS - American Heart Association upon hire.

title: Otolaryngologist
description:
Role: Otolaryngologist (ENT)
Locations: Corning, NY/Binghamton, NY/Sayre, PA
Type: FTE/Permanent

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver comprehensive adult ENT care; provide general ENT services for pediatric patients
  • Participate in sub-specialty care (Head & Neck, Rhinology, Otology) per training and interest
  • Perform clinic and OR duties with APP support, maintaining high-quality, patient-centered outcomes
  • Collaborate within a multidisciplinary team; participate in teaching (residents/medical students) as desired
  • Contribute to quality improvement, protocol development, and program growth

Requirements
  • MD/DO; completion of an ACGME-accredited Otolaryngology residency
  • Board Eligible/Board Certified in Otolaryngology (ABOTO/ABMS)
  • Eligible for medical licensure in Pennsylvania and New York
  • Strong surgical and clinical skills; commitment to teamwork and patient experience

title: Registered Nurse - NICU
description:
Role: Registered Nurse (RN) – NICU
Location: Apple Valley, CA
Type: Full-Time, Night Shift (12-hour)
Work Arrangement: Onsite
Job Summary
Provide compassionate, evidence-based neonatal intensive care to high-risk newborns and their families in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment. Deliver safe, high-quality clinical care while upholding patient advocacy, continuous improvement, and whole-person care.
Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver direct bedside care (assessment, planning, implementation, evaluation).
  • Administer meds; monitor hemodynamics, ventilatory support, and feeding plans per protocols.
  • Collaborate with neonatologists, NNPs, RTs, lactation, and ancillary teams.
  • Educate and support families on condition, plan, safety, and discharge readiness.
  • Document accurately and on time in the EHR.
  • Participate in unit-based quality, safety, and shared governance.
  • Adhere to infection prevention, patient safety, and regulatory standards.
Requirements
  • California RN license (upon hire)
  • BLS (AHA) and NRP (AAP) (upon hire)
  • Graduation from an accredited nursing program (Associate's or higher)
  • 1–2 years recent RN NICU experience in an acute care hospital
Preferred Skills
  • BSN
  • Experience in Level II/III NICU
  • Proficiency with neonatal ventilators, CPAP/HFNC, IV therapy, and EHR documentation
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and family-centered care focus
